examples.arabic: يقدم ابي هدية جميلة لاخي بعد تناول العشاء
examples.english: My father presents a beautiful gift to my brother after eating dinner.
examples.transliteration: Yuqaddimu abee hadiyyatan jameelatan liakhee bada tanaawul alashaa

examples.arabic: كانت التوقعات مرتفعة للامسية المذهلة التي اعدها شقيقه الاصغر لتقديم هدية استثنائية
examples.english: Expectations were high for the astonishing evening his younger brother had prepared to present an exceptional gift.
examples.transliteration: Kanat al-tawaqqu'at murtafi'a lil-amsiya al-mudhhila allati a'addaha shaqiqahu al-asghar li-taqdim hadiya istithna'iya.
